title: Add cohort-aware changelog enricher and perf baseline seeder
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Introduce a cohort-aware changelog enrichment pipeline and a perf baseline seeder to improve release notes quality and initial performance expectations for newly onboarded model variants. The change adds an enrichment worker that consumes sampled telemetry and onboarding probe results, computes sample-weighted deltas per cohort, and emits human-readable summary assertions and suggested baseline numbers for the release composer. A lightweight SQLite indexer records cohort sample weights and fast lookup keys to avoid recomputing on every run. The PR also adds a small CLI entrypoint (rmr changelog enrich) and a seed script that writes initial baseline entries into the model registry so downstream automation and dashboards have an initial reference. Motivation: reduce manual work for release authors, provide reproducible baseline numbers for canary rollouts, and improve changelog context for customers. No breaking API changes to existing onboard manifests; the enrichment is opt-in via registry config and feature flag.

review_comments: Marta Kovac: Overall LGTM. Two requests: 1) ensure the indexer uses a streaming cursor to avoid high memory use for large sample dumps, 2) add a short note about privacy implications when sampling user prompts.
Priya Natarajan: Addressed both. Indexer now streams rows and an opt-out sampling flag was added. Updated docs to call out collection window and anonymization in changelog_enricher.md.
Diego Alvarez: Can the seed script be idempotent? If we run seed_baselines twice we should not duplicate entries.
Priya Natarajan: Seed script now uses upsert semantics keyed by model_id+variant+cohort_hash. Added test that runs seed twice to ensure idempotency.
Samir Patel: Integration test shows a 2s median extra latency when enrichment runs inline during onboarding; recommend running as background job for heavy models.
Priya Natarajan: Switched default to background worker with a flag to run inline for quick local dev. Noted tradeoff in docs.
notes_on_testing: Added unit tests for indexer boundary conditions and a small end-to-end CI job that runs seed_baselines against a dev registry snapshot. Integration test that hit sampling flakiness now retries up to 2 times and records flake metadata for triage.
release_notes: Adds cohort-aware changelog enrichment and initial perf baseline seeding. The enrichment computes sample-weighted deltas to produce concise release notes and seeds initial baseline numbers for variants to aid canary rollouts and dashboards. Opt-in via registry config and feature flag. No breaking changes.
related_tickets: ENG-4490: seed initial perf baselines from sampled telemetry
manual_steps: To enable enrichment for a registry: 1) set registry.config.enricher.enabled=true, 2) run scripts/seed_baselines.py --registry <url> --since 30d, 3) ensure background worker service is deployed (deploy/enricher.yml).
impact_summary: Improves release note clarity and provides reproducible perf baselines for newly onboarded variants. Expected to reduce time spent by release authors and reduce canary regressions. Small runtime cost if run inline; default is background worker to avoid onboarding latency.
